mapper.sql: FROM attendance_daily d INNER JOIN employee e ON e.id = d.employee_id AND e.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN workplace wp ON wp.id = e.workplace_id AND wp.tenant_id = e.tenant_id LEFT JOIN department dept ON dept.id = e.department_id AND dept.tenant_id = e.tenant_id LEFT JOIN attendance_exception ex ON ex.id = ( SELECT MAX(sub_ex.id) FROM attendance_exception sub_ex WHERE sub_ex.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND sub_ex.attendance_daily_id = d.id ) LEFT JOIN attendance_case c ON c.id = ( SELECT MAX(sub_c.id) FROM attendance_case sub_c WHERE sub_c.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND sub_c.attendance_daily_id = d.id )
mapper.select:
SELECT c.id AS case_id, d.id AS attendance_daily_id, d.employee_id AS employee_id, e.employee_no, e.employee_name, wp.workplace_name, dept.department_name, d.work_date, COALESCE(ex.exception_type, d.status) AS current_exception, COALESCE(c.case_type, ex.exception_type, d.status) AS case_type, COALESCE(c.case_status, 'UNHANDLED') AS case_status, d.handling_status, c.applicant_id, c.applicant_role, c.current_approver_id, c.submitted_at, COALESCE(c.updated_at, d.updated_at) AS updated_at, d.locked_flag, CASE WHEN c.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pseudo_case
WHERE ORDER BY d.work_date DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT CASE WHEN d.locked_flag = 1 THEN 'LOCKED' WHEN c.case_status IS NOT NULL THEN c.case_status WHEN d.exception_flag = 1 THEN 'UNHANDLED' ELSE d.handling_status END AS bucket, COUNT(1) AS totalCount
WHERE GROUP BY CASE WHEN d.locked_flag = 1 THEN 'LOCKED' WHEN c.case_status IS NOT NULL THEN c.case_status WHEN d.exception_flag = 1 THEN 'UNHANDLED' ELSE d.handling_status END

SELECT c.id AS case_id, d.id AS attendance_daily_id, d.employee_id AS employee_id, e.employee_no, e.employee_name, wp.workplace_name, dept.department_name, d.work_date, COALESCE(ex.exception_type, d.status) AS current_exception, c.case_type, c.case_status, d.handling_status, c.applicant_id, c.applicant_role, c.current_approver_id, c.submitted_at, c.updated_at, d.locked_flag, 0 AS pseudo_case, c.reason_category, c.reason_text, c.expected_resolution, d.final_status, d.final_clock_in, d.final_clock_out, d.final_break_minutes, d.final_remark FROM attendance_case c INNER JOIN attendance_daily d ON d.id = c.attendance_daily_id AND d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id INNER JOIN employee e ON e.id = d.employee_id AND e.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN workplace wp ON wp.id = e.workplace_id AND wp.tenant_id = e.tenant_id LEFT JOIN department dept ON dept.id = e.department_id AND dept.tenant_id = e.tenant_id LEFT JOIN attendance_exception ex ON ex.id = ( SELECT MAX(sub_ex.id) FROM attendance_exception sub_ex WHERE sub_ex.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND sub_ex.attendance_daily_id = d.id ) WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_case ( tenant_id, attendance_daily_id, employee_id, workplace_id, department_id, case_type, case_status, applicant_id, applicant_role, current_approver_id, reason_category, reason_text, expected_resolution, patch_payload_json, submitted_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{attendanceDailyId}, #{employeeId}, #{workplaceId}, #{departmentId}, #{caseType}, #{caseStatus}, #{applicantId}, #{applicantRole}, #{currentApproverId}, #{reasonCategory}, #{reasonText}, #{expectedResolution}, #{patchPayloadJson}, #{submittedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS case_id, d.id AS attendance_daily_id, d.employee_id AS employee_id, e.employee_no, e.employee_name, wp.workplace_name, dept.department_name, d.work_date, COALESCE(ex.exception_type, d.status) AS current_exception, c.case_type, c.case_status, d.handling_status, c.applicant_id, c.applicant_role, c.current_approver_id, c.submitted_at, c.updated_at, d.locked_flag, 0 AS pseudo_case, c.reason_category, c.reason_text, c.expected_resolution, d.final_status, d.final_clock_in, d.final_clock_out, d.final_break_minutes, d.final_remark FROM attendance_case c INNER JOIN attendance_daily d ON d.id = c.attendance_daily_id AND d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id INNER JOIN employee e ON e.id = d.employee_id AND e.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN workplace wp ON wp.id = e.workplace_id AND wp.tenant_id = e.tenant_id LEFT JOIN department dept ON dept.id = e.department_id AND dept.tenant_id = e.tenant_id LEFT JOIN attendance_exception ex ON ex.id = ( SELECT MAX(sub_ex.id) FROM attendance_exception sub_ex WHERE sub_ex.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND sub_ex.attendance_daily_id = d.id ) WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.attendance_daily_id = #{attendanceDailyId} ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_case SET case_status = #{caseStatus}, current_approver_id = #{currentApproverId}, patch_payload_json = #{patchPayloadJson}, approved_at = #{approvedAt}, rejected_at = #{rejectedAt}, locked_at = #{lockedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_case_action_log ( tenant_id, attendance_case_id, action_type, operator_id, operator_role, action_comment, before_snapshot_json, after_snapshot_json, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{attendanceCaseId}, #{actionType}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorRole}, #{actionComment}, #{beforeSnapshotJson}, #{afterSnapshotJson}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
